definitions.explanation: In a way that is easy to see, understand, or prove; without doubt or ambiguity.

examples.japanese: {明|あき}らかに{間違|まちが}っている。
{彼|かれ}は{明|あき}らかに{疲|つか}れていた。
{結果|けっか}は{明|あき}らかに{改善|かいぜん}している。

notes:
{明|あき}らかに is the adverbial form of the na-adjective {明|あき}らか (clear, obvious). It means "clearly" or "obviously" and is used when something is evident beyond reasonable doubt.

FORMATION:
{明|あき}らか (na-adjective) → {明|あき}らかに (adverb)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {明|あき}らかに～だ: is clearly ~
- {明|あき}らかに{違|ちが}う: clearly different
- {明|あき}らかに{間違|まちが}っている: obviously wrong
- {明|あき}らかになる: to become clear, to come to light

SIMILAR EXPRESSIONS:
- はっきり: clearly (more colloquial, also means distinctly)
- {確|たし}かに: certainly, indeed (acknowledges a point)
- {明確|めいかく}に: clearly, explicitly (more formal, often written)

REGISTER:
Used in both spoken and written Japanese. Slightly more formal than はっきり but less formal than {明確|めいかく}に.
